<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>

The source is fetched from a known upstream Git repository (GitHub, with fallback mirrors on Codeberg and Gitea), and the `prepare()` function includes logic to attempt cloning from alternative mirrors if the primary source fails. This is a reasonable redundancy mechanism and not inherently malicious.
